1879073010.name: Savage Strikes
1879073010.desc: Makes a pair of savage attacks, followed by a quick off-hand swipe.

1879097202.name: Bird-speech
1879097202.desc: Summons a little bird-friend to brighten your day.

1879112562.name: Quite a Snag
1879112562.desc: Activated by Double-edged Strike, you attack an enemy below the belt, setting them off-balance and increasing the damage they take further if they already suffer from Reveal Weakness.

conditionalEffects.description: A Small Snag will spread Reveal Weakness to nearby enemies when used on a target already suffering from A Small Snag.

1879136242.name: Menacing Roar
1879136242.desc: You roar ferociously, weakening enemies around you.

conditionalEffects.description: Your shouts have a chance to apply Clinging Fear to your target. Your melee skills will capitalize on this fear, turning it into the Unrelenting Curses DoT effect.

1879146738.name: Steady Hands
1879146738.desc:
Refocuses attunement from one extreme to the other.

After use, skills cost reduced Power. 
 
 Requires either Battle or Healing Attunement.

1879157618.name: Melt Armour
1879157618.desc: A tactical attack that reduces target armour.

1879161458.name: Charge that doesn't break stealth on self

1879191026.name: Dúnedain Mark
1879191026.desc: The Dúnedain excel at stalking their prey, and few indeed can escape their notice. This skill is the prerequisite of Fly True.

1879191794.name: Archer
1879191794.desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle, who has trained as an Archer.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish. Can be used while in combat.</rgb>

1879201138.name: Hatchlings: Strong Brood
1879201138.desc: You summon one of your strong brood to aid you in battle. Strong brood hatchlings are more durable than other hatchlings and focus on melee attacks.

1879208434.name: Treasure Laden Horse
1879208434.desc: A horse laden with the spoils of a treasure hunt!

1879214578.name: The Boot
1879214578.desc: A powerful kick which interrupts inductions.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks once.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 2 times.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 3 times.

1879222130.name: Improved Hedge
1879222130.desc: You make a melee attack, securing your weapons and altering your fighting position to make greater use of your armour and attempting to secure yourself from wounds. This will also now grant you more critical defence.

1879234290.name: Split Shot: Hail of Fire
1879234290.desc: Looses multiple arrows at once, hitting several targets in a small area.\n\nArrows inflict fire damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879248370.name: Spread of Arrows - Light
1879248370.desc: Steadying yourself on your War-steed, you release several Light-based damage projectiles toward your target.

1879250034.name: Staggering Slash
1879250034.desc: A brutal strike against rider and steed, this slash is meant to weaken your enemy, leaving them susceptible to further attack.

1879251058.name: Use Hobbit-sense
1879251058.desc: Samwise Gamgee may not be strong, or fast, or indeed very smart... but he has plain old hobbit-sense and it serves him well.

1879272178.name: Hero's Strike
1879272178.desc: A melee attack that increases the effects of healing on yourself.\n\nRestores your Morale.

procEffects.description: Damaging skills have a  *  chance to make your next healing skill crit.
Scoring a Critical Hit increases Outgoing Healing by 10% for 10s. You cannot gain this effect more than once every 25s.

1879274098.name: Snap Shot - Stealthed Ambush
1879274098.desc: When attacking from stealth, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879301234.name: Guide to Helm's Deep
1879301234.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Helm's Deep in western Rohan.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879320178.name: Steed of the Ship-kings
1879320178.desc: A horse from the defenders of Pelargir.

1879385074.name: Herald of the Northern Star
1879385074.desc: A pony from the Yule Festival.

1879394418.name: Harnessed Shepherd Dog
1879394418.desc: Brings out a harnessed shepherd dog to keep you company.

1879396850.name: Muster in Estolad Lân
1879396850.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Estolad Lân

1879400050.name: Elk of Festive Spirit
1879400050.desc: An Elk steed perfect for winter celebrations.

1879409266.name: Bugan Finder
1879409266.desc: You will be guaranteed to encounter a Treasure Bugan, provided you are in an instance where Treasure Bugans already spawn.

1879410034.name: Muster in Annâk-khurfu
1879410034.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Annâk-khurfu in Elderslade.

1879410802.name: Sporting Steed
1879410802.desc: A steed with minimal trappings, perfect for navigating dense forests and jumping obstacles.

1879418738.name: Facepaint - Star
1879418738.desc: Apply facepaint to your cheek with a star pattern.

1879428082.name: Camaraderie
1879428082.desc: Places a buff on self and nearby allies that increases damage by 10% and Incoming Healing by 10%.

1879463026.name: Feisty Wolverine
1879463026.desc: Summons a feisty wolverine to accompany you on your journeys.

1879467250.name: Guided by the Stars
1879467250.desc: Sing a tale of the stars, reminding you and your allies of your direction and purpose.

conditionalEffects.description: Shanties will restore the morale of affected allies.

1879470578.name: Waves of Grass
1879470578.desc: Even waves of grass can inspire an uplifting song.

1879480306.name: Return to the Bloody Eagle Tavern
1879480306.desc: You're able to quickly return to the Bloody Eagle Tavern in Umbar Baharbêl. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879495154.name: Confusing Map
1879495154.desc: A map that leads to fantastic treasures and riches. If only one could read it...

1879497714.name: Major Pet Command
1879497714.desc: Command your pet to execute a major skill on themselves or their target.

1879508594.name: Crimson Deep-claw Whelp
1879508594.desc: Summons a crimson deep-claw whelp to accompany you on your travels.

1879526258.name: Smelt Dull Stones
1879526258.desc: Melt down many dull stones into a bar of purified metal.
